item.title: Friends of Watership Down Health — accounts inspection opens
item.description: Accounts available for inspection at Oakley surgery from Monday 15 June (also Overton and Kingsclere — those sites out of Oakley scope). Inspection window runs until the Friends AGM on 29 June (Overton — separate notice, not calendarled here). Contact Chair Sue Berry 01256 770565 or Secretary Sue Carter 01256 770681.
